name: Jiangsu Asia Electronics Technology
aliases: 江苏亚电科技股份有限公司
Jiangsu Asia Electronics Technology Co., Ltd.
notes:
Applicant for a first-time public offering on the SSE STAR Market; not yet listed at the date of this filing draft, so it has no stock code. Business scope as the filing states it (p23, p110): R&D, manufacture and sale of WET CLEANING equipment for silicon-based semiconductor, compound-semiconductor and photovoltaic applications, used in the wet cleaning step of front-end wafer manufacturing. It makes BOTH batch/bath (槽式) and single-wafer (单片式) cleaners: the issuer states batch cleaners serve 40 nm and above and single-wafer cleaners below 40 nm, that its process coverage satisfies all wet processes for batch tools and for single-wafer tools at 28 nm and above, and that it has only an R&D footprint at 14 nm. It does NOT make etch, deposition, lithography or test equipment. A material and growing part of its revenue is photovoltaic cell wet-process equipment, which is not semiconductor equipment.
